map.最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传。可展开: Your last successful result is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Clearing site data removes the record.
map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:
map.用无 STUN 的 WebRTC host candidate 收集本机内网地址: Collect your local private IP addresses via WebRTC host candidates (no STUN) and flag mDNS-obfuscated ones.
map.创建不带 STUN 服务器的 RTCPeerConnection，通过本地 SD: Creates an RTCPeerConnection without a STUN server and reads local NIC addresses from local SDP host candidates, closing after 3 seconds. No external server is contacted.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「收集本机地址」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Collect addresses" above to start.
map.host candidate 中的局域网地址及协议: LAN addresses from host candidates with protocol
map.浏览器用 .local 后缀隐藏的真实地址: Real addresses hidden by browsers using .local suffixes
map.为什么需要点击按钮？: Why must I click a button?
map.浏览器要求 WebRTC 由用户手势触发，页面加载后需手动点一次「收集本机地址」: Browsers require WebRTC to be triggered by a user gesture, so click once after the page loads.
map.部分浏览器启用 mDNS 混淆，真实内网 IP 被替换成随机 .local 域名: Some browsers enable mDNS obfuscation, replacing real private IPs with random .local names for privacy.
map.会逐个列出所有 host candidate，包括蓝牙、虚拟网卡等产生的地址。: Yes, all host candidates are listed, including Bluetooth and virtual adapters.
